stem: Which quotation shows that Marie-Laure is referring to the model in her kitchen as she finds her way home?

options.label: A
options.text: They start up the length of the rue Cuvier.

options.label: B
options.text: This street intersects this street intersects this street. One centimeter at a time.

options.label: D
options.text: Instead she squats on her heels on the sidewalk.
